<infobox theme="Substance">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="locations"><label>Location(s)</label></data>
        <data source="date"><label>Date discovered</label></data>	
        <data source="discovered"><label>Discovered by</label></data>
        <data source="creators"><label>Creator(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="created"><label>Date created</label></data>		
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical specifications</header>
        <data source="type"><label>Substance type</label></data>			
        <data source="color"><label>Color</label></data>
        <data source="properties"><label>Properties</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Usage and history</header>
        <data source="uses"><label>Use(s)</label></data>
        <data source="cost"><label>Cost</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Substance|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
